D10-STOP-01.evidence: Actual stop_telegram_control on a blocked poller returned STOP_INCOMPLETE_WORKER_ALIVE, kept the thread, and allowed a later stop or exit to be distinguished from the timeout.

D10-DB-01.evidence: Delayed polls, stop-before-dispatch, stop while waiting for _pg_lock, and an in-flight locked query were exercised on the actual worker and database helper. No post-release Telegram query or reconnection occurred.
remaining_failure_windows: app.py still ignores the stop status. Reachable cleanup does not release the database while a Telegram worker exists, because release happens only after startup failure and Telegram start is the last startup statement.

D10-TEL-02.evidence: Start while the old worker was alive did not create a second thread and did not clear the stop event. Concurrent starts and concurrent start/stop kept one worker. Restart worked after the old worker exited.
